text: Current mk_gecko_rev_replacement returns zero or one nested replacement triples. Callers use extend so unchanged values contribute nothing. Entry 481 exactly restored original 465 changed-file content, including the older flat triple plus append. The original release-to-ESR fix was accepted after a reported Try run, but its shared review later records that central-to-beta broke, as an author recollection. Bug 1905941 gives the absent GECKO_HEAD_REV KeyError for a later backout; it does not establish that precise cause for entry 481. Keep the current helper/caller shape paired and validate each branch transition. Neither append nor extend is a repository-wide preference. Proposed manual Python rule: document and verify collection shape at helper boundaries, including optional no-op results. This refines the already-published shape note and preserves the consistent transition lessons; no merge or runtime test was run.
title: Match a replacement helper return shape to append or extend
